articles.title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
articles.snippet: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin remains locked in range as stocks notch another new record high
articles.snippet: FxPro says a slide below $84,000 would hand control to sellers and put $80,000 in play. Minutes from the Fed's last meeting come out Wednesday.

articles.title: Smaller altcoins shine as bitcoin stills trades around $85,000
articles.snippet: Leading the gains is BTW, the native token of Bitway, a bitcoin-compatible layer-1, which jumped 25% in the past 24 hours and is up 170% over the past 30 days.

articles.title: U.S.- China AI race heats up as Chinese rivals secure billions ahead of IPOs
articles.snippet: DeepSeek and Moonshot attract fresh capital ahead of planned listings, while OpenAI courts major investors.

articles.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test gets last-minute fix before major capacity jump
articles.snippet: One of Ethereum’s main validator clients updated its software hours before a Sepolia test that will raise the amount of work each block can hold to 200 million gas.
